In her American debut, she was brought to Madison Square Garden by a theatrical manager played by Adolphe Menjou. In One in a Million, Happy Landing, and Sun Valley Serenade she appeared on ice, showcasing the talent with which she won six European championships, a record equaled by Irina Slutskaya and Katarina Witt. FTP, name this figure skater, who won three Olympic gold medals and ten world figure skating championships between 1927 and 1936.
